articles.title: Cada cuántos días se deben cambiar todas las contraseñas de redes sociales y correos
articles.text:
Cambiar las contraseñas puede reducir los riesgos de acceso no autorizado, pero la frecuencia adecuada depende de la solidez de cada clave y del tipo de cuenta protegida. Redes sociales, servicios bancarios, plataformas de trabajo y aplicaciones con información sensible requieren contraseñas únicas, robustas y difíciles de descifrar.
Una clave simple, de hasta siete caracteres, puede caer en manos de un cibercriminal en apenas dos segundos mediante herramientas automatizadas.El hábito de actualizar credenciales tiene incluso una fecha dedicada en Estados Unidos: cada 1 de febrero se celebra el Change Your Password Day.
De acuerdo con Eset, el cambio periódico puede ser útil, aunque no existe una regla única para todos los usuarios y servicios. La empresa de ciberseguridad recomienda analizar la composición de la contraseña, la importancia de la cuenta y la existencia de posibles filtraciones antes de decidir cuándo renovarla.
La regla de los 90 días no siempre ofrece más seguridad
Durante años se extendió la recomendación de modificar las contraseñas cada 90 días. Sin embargo, esta práctica no garantiza por sí sola una mejora relevante de la seguridad. El especialista Lance Spitzner, en un análisis publicado por Sans, considera que el beneficio es reducido frente al costo que implica para las empresas obligar a sus usuarios o empleados a renovar las claves con frecuencia.
Spitzner plantea que esos recursos podrían emplearse en enseñar a utilizar contraseñas únicas y seguras, además de facilitar gestores de contraseñas y sistemas de verificación en dos pasos. La idea central es que una clave sólida y exclusiva para cada servicio ofrece una barrera más efectiva que cambios periódicos que no modifican realmente la estructura de la contraseña.
Un estudio de la Universidad Carnegie Mellon también observó una conducta repetida: cuando los usuarios deben cambiar sus claves con demasiada frecuencia, suelen aplicar variaciones mínimas. Cambian el mes, el año o un número final, una solución sencilla de recordar, pero previsible para quien intenta vulnerar la cuenta.
Cuáles son los tiempos indicados para cambiar contraseñas
La empresa de seguridad digital plantea una orientación basada en la complejidad de cada contraseña. Una clave de 10 caracteres que solo combina letras mayúsculas y minúsculas debería cambiarse cada mes, pues ese sería el periodo estimado en que podría ser vulnerada.
La frecuencia puede espaciarse si se incorporan números. En ese caso, el cambio podría realizarse cada seis meses. Si la contraseña además incluye símbolos, la actualización puede hacerse de forma anual. Estos plazos no eliminan la necesidad de actuar antes cuando existe una sospecha de filtración, un acceso extraño o una brecha de seguridad.
Las claves bancarias merecen una atención distinta. Suelen ser más cortas y protegen información financiera, por lo que conviene cambiarlas con mayor frecuencia. La contraseña funciona como la llave de entrada a la vida digital: protege cuentas, datos personales, dinero y recursos frente a accesos no autorizados.
Qué no se debe hacer al crear una contraseña
El primer paso consiste en crear una contraseña robusta, con una extensión considerable y una combinación de mayúsculas, minúsculas, números y caracteres especiales. Claves como “123456” o “password” siguen apareciendo entre las más utilizadas y no ofrecen una protección suficiente frente a ataques automatizados.
También es esencial evitar la reutilización. Usar una sola contraseña para el correo electrónico, las redes sociales, la banca y otros servicios equivale a utilizar la misma llave para la vivienda, el automóvil y una caja fuerte. Si un atacante obtiene una de esas credenciales, podrá probarla en otras plataformas.
Actualizar una contraseña sin señales de que haya sido filtrada no siempre la hace más segura. La prioridad debe estar en su calidad, en su exclusividad y en la capacidad del usuario para administrarla sin recurrir a anotaciones inseguras.
Los gestores y el doble factor refuerzan la protección
Las contraseñas no deben guardarse en papeles, notas adhesivas, hojas de cálculo ni documentos de texto dentro del dispositivo. Tampoco resulta recomendable almacenarlas en el navegador. La alternativa indicada es un administrador de contraseñas, que permite proteger todas las claves mediante una única contraseña maestra.
El otro aliado es el doble factor de autenticación o 2FA. Esta capa adicional dificulta el acceso de terceros incluso si ya obtuvieron una contraseña. Puede requerir algo que la persona sabe, como una clave; algo que posee, como un teléfono o token; o una característica personal, como la huella dactilar o el iris.
La revisión periódica de las credenciales, el uso de gestores y la activación del 2FA permiten proteger mejor las cuentas. Cambiar una contraseña debe ser una decisión vinculada a su complejidad, al valor de la información que protege y a cualquier señal de posible compromiso.

articles.title: Un mini PC performant pour moins de 200€, c'est possible grâce à cette offre d'Amazon
articles.text:
Si vous cherchez un mini PC qui se contente d’assurer les tâches bureautiques à un prix très attractif, rendez-vous sur Amazon où le GMKtec G5S est disponible à prix cassé puisqu’il est vendu avec une remise de 30 %.
Avec sa connectique complète, le GMKtec G5S vous permettra de brancher plusieurs SSD pour continuer vos tâches commencées au bureau directement depuis chez vous. Pour qu’il soit efficace, la marque l’a équipé d’un Intel N5095 et de 8 Go de RAM pour assurer un multitâche fluide.
Sur Amazon, le GMKtec G5S passe de 289,96 euros à 196,29 euros
Pourquoi choisir le GMKtec G5S ?
- Un mini PC polyvalent : Les professionnels trouveront leur bonheur avec ce mini PC qui compte sur l’Intel N5095 et 8 Go pour assurer les tâches bureautiques avec plusieurs onglets ouverts.
- Un format discret : Si l’on met de côté ce bouton vert qui ternit sa discrétion, le GMKtec G5S ne fait que 7,1 cm de longueur et de largeur pour quatre cm de hauteur. Il pourra ainsi se glisser sous l’écran de votre bureau.
- Pour le prix : Le GMKtec G5S est actuellement proposé pour moins de 200 euros, c’est une excellente affaire pour un mini PC qui possède une telle configuration.
Une connectique à toute épreuve
Pour moins de 200 euros, il ne faut pas s’attendre à avoir une machine de guerre si vous achetez ce GMKtec G5S. La marque l’a doté de l’Intel N5095 et de 8 Go de RAM. C’est suffisant pour créer des tableaux, rédiger des documents et envoyer des mails. Au-delà de cet usage, le mini PC risque de rapidement devenir inefficace.
Si les performances sont moyennes, il y a un point où ce GMKtec G5S brille : la connectique. La marque offre trois ports USB-A, un port USB-C pour venir brancher un SSD externe et pallier les 128 Go qui peuvent rapidement devenir insuffisants. Un port microSD et un port HDMI sont aussi présents.
Des défauts oubliés par le prix
Vous l’aurez compris, vous allez rapidement arriver au bout des performances de ce GMKtec G5S. Cependant, vous n’aurez pas une meilleure proposition pour moins de 200 euros. Le constructeur est conscient des limites de son produit et assure que son mini PC continuera d’être silencieux même lorsque vous le poussez dans ses retranchements.
Autre point qui peut poser problème : le design. Il oscille entre le gris et le noir. Si GMKtec s’était arrêté ici, cela n’aurait pas été un souci, mais la marque a mis le bouton d’alimentation en vert, ce qui vient clairement casser la sobriété de ce boîtier.
Pourtant, GMKtec s'était appliqué pour sortir un produit discret avec un petit appareil prenant la forme d’un carré de 7,1 cm de longueur pour moins de 5 cm de hauteur.
✅ Les points forts
- L’Intel Intel N5095 et 8 Go de RAM pour les performances
- Un tout petit format
- Une connectique très complète
❌ Les limites
- Un design pas des plus discrets avec le bouton d'alimentation vert
- Adapté uniquement à la bureautique, ce qui est normal vu le prix
Le GMKtec G5S est affiché à 196,29 euros au lieu de 289,96 euros sur Amazon
Pour 200 euros, une question se pose : le GMKtec G5S est-il un mini PC qui vaut le coup ? La réponse est oui, si vous souhaitez avoir un ordinateur fixe pour vos journées en télétravail sans avoir à acheter un ordinateur portable. Cependant, il se destine aux principales tâches bureautiques comme l’édition de texte ou la lecture de mails.

Colorful iGame X870E Ultra-S V14 Gaming and OC Motherboard Launches for $284
Colorful has just released its latest overclocking motherboard, the X870E Ultra-S V14, a new E-ATX unit with 16+2+1 power phases, five M.2 slots, and plenty of high-speed I/O. The new motherboard, as shared by IT Home, is priced at 1,899 CNY, which comes out to around $284 at the time of writing, although it only seems to be available in China for the time being. The iGame X870E Ultra-S V14 is explicitly marketed to overclockers on AMD's AM5 platform, bearing XMP/EXPO memory overclocking and asynchronous BCLK CPU overclocking, a digital debug display, EZ Debug diagnosis, and easily accessible rear I/O buttons for both clear CMOS and BIOS updates. 
The motherboard also features Wi-Fi 7 and 5 GbE networking built-in, alongside expansive rear I/O that includes: 4× USB Type-A 5 Gbps, 3× USB Type-A 10 Gbps, 2× USB Type-A 2.0, 2× USB4 40 Gbps, and both 3.5 mm line in/out ports and SPDIF out for audio. Colorful claims that its 16+2+1 VRMs are capable of 80 A, and the VRMs are covered by beefy aluminium heat sinks. It also has five M.2 slots for expanded storage, each with its own heat sink. The Colorful iGame X870E Ultra-S V14 is available on JD.com at the time of writing.

articles.title: Cómo usar Windows RE: el salvavidas oculto de Microsoft cuando cuando Windows deja de funcionar en el PC
articles.text:
Windows no siempre arranca como debería, y cuando eso ocurre no hace falta recurrir a un técnico ni reinstalar el sistema desde cero. Existe una herramienta integrada que puede resolver buena parte de esos problemas sin perder archivos ni configuraciones.
Se trata de Windows RE, abreviatura de Windows Recovery Environment o entorno de recuperación de Windows. Viene preinstalado de forma predeterminada en Windows 10 y Windows 11, en todas sus ediciones de escritorio, así como en Windows Server 2016 y versiones posteriores.
Windows RE es el entorno de recuperación que permite reparar las causas más comunes de los sistemas operativos que no logran arrancar, sin necesidad de reinstalar Windows desde cero ni perder archivos personales. Funciona como un sistema operativo complementario que carga solo lo necesario para diagnosticar y corregir fallos.
La herramienta se basa en el Entorno de preinstalación de Windows, conocido como Windows PE, y puede personalizarse con controladores adicionales, idiomas extra y componentes opcionales. No debe confundirse con el modo seguro de Windows, aunque ambos cumplen funciones similares de diagnóstico.
Cuándo conviene usar Windows RE
Conviene acceder a Windows RE ante problemas críticos que impiden usar el escritorio con normalidad. El caso más habitual es un equipo atrapado en un bucle de reinicios o que muestra una pantalla negra o azul antes de llegar al inicio de sesión.
También es útil cuando una actualización reciente provoca fallos y es necesario desinstalarla, algo que ocurre con más frecuencia de la deseada. Lo mismo sucede si se busca volver a un punto de restauración anterior, creado cuando el sistema funcionaba con normalidad.
El entorno resulta la vía indicada para ejecutar comandos de reparación avanzados desde el Símbolo del sistema, como chkdsk para el disco, sfc /scannow para escanear archivos del sistema o bootrec para reparar el sector de arranque.
Windows RE propio incluye, además, la detección automática de fallos. El sistema activa el entorno de recuperación tras dos intentos fallidos consecutivos de inicio, dos apagados inesperados en los primeros dos minutos tras completar el arranque, o un error de arranque seguro.
Por último, cuando el sistema está demasiado dañado para una reparación puntual, Windows RE ofrece la opción de restablecer el equipo, con la posibilidad de conservar o eliminar los archivos personales durante el proceso.
Cómo acceder al entorno de recuperación de Windows
El método de acceso depende del estado en que se encuentre el equipo. Si todavía es posible iniciar sesión con normalidad, basta con entrar en Configuración, ir a Sistema y luego a Recuperación, para hacer clic en Reiniciar ahora dentro de la sección de inicio avanzado.
Una alternativa más rápida, también con el escritorio accesible, consiste en pulsar el menú Inicio, hacer clic en el icono de encendido y, manteniendo pulsada la tecla Mayúsculas, seleccionar Reiniciar. Esto activa Windows RE en lugar de un reinicio normal.
Si el equipo está bloqueado en la pantalla de contraseña, el procedimiento es similar: se hace clic en el icono de encendido visible en esa pantalla y, sin soltar la tecla Mayúsculas, se selecciona Reiniciar hasta ver la pantalla azul de “Elegir una opción”.
Cuando Windows no arranca en absoluto, existe un tercer método basado en el apagado forzado. Consiste en encender el equipo y, al ver el logotipo de inicio, mantener presionado el botón físico de encendido durante diez segundos para forzar el apagado.
Repetir esta operación dos veces más y dejar que el equipo arranque con normalidad en el tercer intento provoca que Windows detecte los fallos de manera automática y entre en reparación automática, desde donde se accede a las opciones avanzadas de Windows RE.
Las herramientas dentro del menú de recuperación
Una vez dentro del menú de Inicio avanzado, la opción Solucionar problemas concentra la mayoría de las herramientas. Restauración a un momento dado permite volver el equipo al estado en que se encontraba en una fecha anterior, usando puntos de restauración almacenados localmente.
Restablecer este equipo reinstala Windows sin necesidad de un disco externo, aunque el proceso lleva más tiempo y puede requerir reconfigurar aplicaciones. Dentro de Opciones avanzadas aparecen la recuperación rápida de equipo, la desinstalación de actualizaciones y la configuración de inicio, que incluye el modo seguro.

Monday, October 19th 2026
Xbox Strategy Manager Says Studios Avoiding AI Are "Planning for a Fake Future"
Brandon Stirrup, a senior business strategy manager at Xbox, has stirred up quite a debate after posting on X that the games industry is dragging its feet on AI. Over the weekend, Stirrup shared a rough football game he says he "vibe coded" in about three hours of active work, despite never having made a game before, with an AI agent testing and iterating on it. He went on to say that studios not planning around AI are "planning for a fake future." He also said he'd happily take the hit if it meant hundreds of people at Xbox could stop pretending they don't use AI. Here's part of his X rant:
Look if I'm fired tomorrow it will be because I told you the truth that nobody wants you to know. You can make a game with a simple prompt and yes you can make custom, tailored games. Everything you want in a game is right there for the taking, for better or worse. Gaming is the only industry slow-walking the transition because users have negative sentiment. Everyone else accepts reality, Gaming is the only industry where leaders are afraid to talk about AI. Users want the truth. We're using AI.
As expected, the replies piled up fast. His X account went offline less than a day later, and, per PC Gamer citing an Xbox source, he deactivated it because of the volume of responses. Microsoft hasn't commented, and his remarks read more as personal views rather than official Xbox policy. The timing of his admission is quite interesting, though. Microsoft Gaming CEO Asha Sharma has said she wants to embrace AI without "soulless AI slop," and just last week, Xbox also formalized Xbox Labs, a small team exploring AI experiments among other things. Industry sentiment towards AI remains largely negative, with plenty of developers still openly skeptical of generative AI in games.
Sources:
				Brandon Stirrup on X, 				PC Gamer, 				Windows Central

articles.title: Il demande à Claude de créer une application, l'IA découvre un malware caché sur son Mac
articles.text:
Un logiciel de minage de cryptomonnaies était installé sur son Mac, le faisant surchauffer. Quand soudain, Claude, l'IA d'Anthropic, a proposé toute seule, de supprimer le supprimer le logiciel malveillant au cours d'une demande pour créer un logiciel personnalisé.
Un développeur utilisant Claude Code pour créer une application de surveillance de température a reçu un avertissement inattendu de la part de l'agent d'intelligence artificielle. Ce dernier a détecté la présence d'un logiciel de minage de cryptomonnaie installé à l'insu de l'utilisateur sur son ordinateur Mac.
Une découverte accidentelle
L'utilisateur, sous le nom de UntilHEX sur Reddit, travaillait sur le développement d'une application destinée à surveiller la température de son Mac. Puis, soudainement, Claude Code a signalé un problème : "Votre Mac exécute un logiciel de minage de cryptomonnaie que je n'ai pas installé". L'IA a précisé avoir identifié le processus XMRig utilisant environ 1175 % du CPU, soit approximativement 12 cœurs.
Face à cette information, le développeur a reconnu que cela expliquait les performances dégradées de son ordinateur en raison de surchauffes ces derniers temps.
Une surchauffe révélatrice
Selon les éléments consultés, notamment une capture d'écran de la fenêtre Claude Code, ce logiciel malveillant aurait été ajouté à la liste des programmes de démarrage du Mac le 29 août. Depuis cette date, son ordinateur se mettant à chauffer anormalement, le développeur se serait finalement lancé dans l'idée de développer une application de surveillance de la température.
- Agent dans le terminal
- Compréhension du projet
- Intégration à Git avancée
L'intervention de Claude a débuté lorsque le développeur s'est inquiété des relevés bruts des capteurs de température de son Mac, qu'il jugeait anormalement élevés. L'IA a alors confirmé que le processeur atteignait des pics de 112 degrés Celsius, une température qu'il a attribuée à une charge importante, causée par le processus XMRig mobilisant environ 12 cœurs. Le nombre total de cœurs du processeur concerné n'est pas précisé.
Le processus de nettoyage
Claude Code a ensuite détaillé comment le logiciel de minage s'était dissimulé sur l'ordinateur et configuré pour s'exécuter automatiquement au démarrage. L'agent a choisi de ne supprimer ou arrêter aucun élément de sa propre initiative, proposant plutôt son intervention : "Puis-je nettoyer cela maintenant ?", a-t-il demandé, précisant son plan d'action consistant à arrêter le malware et à déplacer les fichiers vers une zone de quarantaine plus sûre.
Dans les commentaires suivant sa publication initiale, UntilHEX a confirmé avoir autorisé Claude à procéder au nettoyage de son ordinateur. Le développeur a indiqué n'avoir dû supprimer manuellement qu'un seul fichier, en raison d'un problème d'accès rencontré par l'IA. Pour lui en tout cas, l'intervention a été efficace. Une analyse via le logiciel Malwarebytes a ensuite été réalisée afin de vérifier que le nettoyage effectué avec l'aide de l'agent d'intelligence artificielle avait bien éliminé la menace.
Source : Tom's Hardware

articles.title: Russian bot activity plunged 84% after Ukraine hit Yandex data centers, but the bots were back at full strength within two days
articles.text:
Russian bot activity plunged 84% after Ukraine hit Yandex data centers, but the bots were back at full strength within two days
Day-long bot collapse saw major drop in traffic
- Ukraine's CCD says suspected Russian bot posts in its sample fell 83.6% on October 8 after a strike shut Yandex's Sasovo data center
- The same data shows volume back above pre-strike levels by October 10, with a smaller 42.6% dip after the Vladimir shutdown
- Cloudflare and Graphika found no comparable drop in Western political communities, though Russian-language Telegram output fell 5% to 15%
Ukraine's Center for Countering Disinformation (CCD) says suspected Russian bot accounts went almost silent after drones knocked out Yandex data centers earlier this month, with message volume across a monitored network falling 83.6% in a single day.
The findings come from an analytical report the CCD dated October 15 2026. Using Osavul monitoring software, analysts tracked 22,664 messages from 5,201 accounts showing signs of inauthentic behavior across 26 topics in Ukraine's Facebook and Telegram space between October 6 and 12.
The 83.6% figure is real, but the same report shows those accounts posting more than before within 48 hours, and independent data from Cloudflare shows that at least some of the malicious automation running on Yandex's cloud did not die so much as move house.
A collapse in automated traffic after the Yandex Cloud took a beating
The first collapse came on October 8, hours after a drone strike and fire shut down Yandex's Sasovo data center in Ryazan region, home to two of the company's three supercomputers.
Daily messages fell from 4,032 to 660, and active accounts dropped from 1,526 to 258. Telegram took the harder hit, down 90%, while Facebook fell 79.5%. A second, shallower dip followed the October 11 strike that Yandex said had completely halted its Vladimir site, with messages falling 42.6% on October 12, from 4,711 to 2,704. A subgroup of 98 accounts the CCD flagged for justifying the invasion or inciting hatred followed the same curve, down 77.8% on October 8 and 49.2% on October 12.
The most telling detail sits in the middle. The October 9 strike at Yandex's Kaluga campus, which the company describes as its largest, only partially took the site offline, and the CCD recorded no fall in activity that day. The two dips line up with the two complete shutdowns, as one would expect if these accounts depended on that infrastructure, though that's not proof on its own.
A surprisingly fast turnaround time?
What the 84% figure that the CCD touts leaves out is how briefly the silence held. Message volume recovered to 2,231 on October 9, then reached 4,585 on October 10 and 4,711 on October 11, both above the pre-strike level. The monitoring window in the report closes on October 12, so it cannot show whether the second dip recovered the same way.

The agency has also been downplaying the event on other forums; two days before the report, the CCD said posting in some clusters of the Pravda, InfoDefense and Nod of Time networks roughly halved for about 12 hours, and stressed that it had not recorded a significant overall decline across Russian bot farms.
On October 16, the CCD's summary of remarks by media literacy head Ivan Slychko described the effect as "a disruption of automation, not the complete disappearance of bots."
It also makes no mention of a similar comparison for ordinary accounts. On the afternoon of October 8, banks, retailers, mobile operators and news sites across Russia suffered outages. Without said information, it is hard to separate bot farms losing their servers from operators inside Russia simply losing connectivity.
The CCD is hardly an impartial player here; it is a body attached to Ukraine's National Security and Defense Council, and it has an incentive to exaggerate victories even when the data doesn't always support them.
President Volodymyr Zelenskyy had already jumped the gun, telling the Warsaw Security Forum that after the strikes "it suddenly became a little easier to breathe on many social media platforms" and that might have been a deciding factor for how the CCD built its narrative.
Beyond Ukraine, the "bots went silent" story mostly rested on a Cloudflare Radar chart showing automated traffic from Yandex's AS13238 network falling to well under 1% of its recent peak on October 11. As we noted at the time, that traffic was far more likely to be crawlers than fake social media accounts, and "bot" is a loose word when automated requests make up around half of all web traffic.
Cloudflare's own post-mortem confirms it. Marina Elmore and Lai Yi Ohlsen found 99.5% of requests from AS13238 were automated, mostly verified Yandex search crawlers, and that the network supplied only about 7% of Russia-origin bot requests. Bot traffic from Russian IP addresses hitting the post, reply, and like endpoints of one social platform dipped just 5.7% across the event period.
Graphika reached a similar verdict from the other direction. Founder John Kelly's analysis of the AfD, MAGA and Reform UK communities that viral posts claimed had gone quiet found none lost their active accounts or heaviest posters.
AfD-linked accounts posted 40,365 times on October 11, 4% below the week before and well within normal swings, while MAGA mentions on X rose 25% in the eight hours after the Vladimir strike. Georgetown's Renée DiResta, writing in Lawfare, was blunt about the viral version: "It's a great story. But it looks like fiction rather than fact."
For now, the most defensible reading of the CCD's numbers is narrower than its headline. Knocking out the right data center can briefly cut the output of Russia-based accounts aimed at Ukraine. Keeping them quiet would mean hitting the servers they move to next, and on the evidence so far, that move takes a day or two.
As one analysis of battlefield computing puts it particularly well, resilience comes from designing for disconnection, and the bot operators appear to have learned that lesson faster than Yandex did.
Via UNITED24 Media

articles.title: La prochaine berline électrique de Xiaomi fait son apparition sur la route, il s'agit de la SU9 LUX, une évolution de la SU7 avec des dimensions allongées
articles.text:
La prochaine berline électrique de Xiaomi fait son apparition sur la route, il s'agit de la SU9 LUX, une évolution de la SU7 avec des dimensions allongées
C’est sous un épais camouflage que la prochaine berline électrique de Xiaomi a été photographiée sur la route. Il s’agit de la future SU9 LUX, une évolution de la SU7 avec une carrosserie et un empattement allongés pour une longueur qui dépasserait les 5,20 mètres.
Les images ont été capturées en Chine et montrent une silhouette très proche de la berline électrique SU7 pour cette SU9 LUX. Xiaomi garde la ligne de toit qui descend vers le coffre, les proportions de berline sportive et les étriers de frein jaunes visibles sur ce prototype. Quant aux portes arrière, elles sont plus longues et la carrosserie s’étire aussi entre celles-ci et le coffre.
Xiaomi prépare la berline électrique SU9 LUX
Le but de Xiaomi est de proposer bien plus d’espace pour les passagers à l’arrière. La SU9 LUX serait donc une évolution de la SU7, qui mise plus sur les performances et le plaisir de conduite. La prochaine berline électrique de Xiaomi chercherait davantage le confort avec une place arrière plus généreuse puisque les automobilistes chinois apprécient les grandes berlines haut de gamme
Depuis des années, des constructeurs européens comme Audi, BMW et Mercedes proposent des versions allongées de plusieurs de leurs modèles spécialement pour le marché chinois. La demande est forte et Xiaomi le sait très bien, comme BYD qui lance régulièrement des véhicules électriques aux dimensions XXL.
Selon les premières estimations, l’empattement serait proche de 3,10 mètres. Le prototype montre aussi un capteur LiDAR sur le toit pour que la berline électrique repère son environnement lors de l’aide à la conduite. D’autres images montrent aussi des roues arrière qui braquent légèrement dans le but de réduire le rayon de braquage et améliorer la stabilité à grande vitesse.
C’est en février dernier que Xiaomi a déposé la marque "Xiaomi SU9 LUX" en Chine, dans une catégorie automobile. Puis cet été, la marque a été publiée pour un examen préliminaire. C’est le mois dernier que la période d’opposition s’est achevée. Pour le moment, Xiaomi n’a pas officiellement dévoilé la SU9 LUX, partagé de date de présentation ou de prix.
Xiaomi lancera ses véhicules en Europe l'an prochain
Xiaomi poursuit donc sa percée sur le marché de l’automobile. Rappelons que cette année, le constructeur chinois a lancé une nouvelle version de la SU7. En août dernier, l’ensemble de la gamme SU7 a dépassé les 500 000 livraisons cumulées en 28,5 mois.
Toutefois, Xiaomi doit faire avec les ventes en baisse en Chine et la SU7 est aussi touchée. Le mois dernier, l’entreprise a livré 15 751 berlines électriques, soit une baisse de 19,55 % sur un an. Une version plus luxueuse de la SU7 permettrait donc à Xiaomi d’élargir son offre. Rappelons que Xiaomi prépare son arrivée en Europe en 2027 avec l’Allemagne comme premier marché.
Est-ce que la SU9 LUX sera disponible sur le Vieux Continent ? On en saura sans doute plus dans les prochains mois quand Xiaomi lancera officiellement ses véhicules électriques en Europe.

articles.title: Dream Labs raises $90M to help build more intelligent robots with simple video feeds - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Dream Labs raises $90M to help build more intelligent robots with simple video feeds
Dream Labs, a startup trying to make robots more intelligent and capable of performing many different tasks, has raised $90 million in seed funding to coincide with the launch of a public application programming interface that provides access to its universal robot foundation model.
Today’s round was jointly led by B Capital and Kindred Ventures and saw the participation of others including A.Capital, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, SV Angel, Scribble VC and angel investor Adrian Aoun.
Dream Labs is taking aim at the lack of intelligence in today’s robots, which might be fairly numerous in many environments but are also fairly limited. The startup believes there are more than 5 million industrial robots working inside factories and warehouses globally. These robots surely do perform useful work, otherwise their owners wouldn’t have invested in them, but Dream Labs co-founder and Chief Executive Joel Jang believes they should be able to do so much more.
What’s stopping them is a lack of expertise and knowledge. Almost all of those 5 million robots are designed to perform a single task, which they do very well. But they cannot be trained to do any other task, nor can they pass on their acquired knowledge to train other robots and machines.
Though the costs of robotic hardware have fallen dramatically, with extremely dextrous robotic arms now selling for just a few thousand dollars, those products don’t ship with any intelligence. Rather, the onus is on the buyer to teach that robotic arm how to do a specific job, and that’s a process that can take many months, because it involves lots of tedious and highly specialized programming work. Worse, whenever new robotic hardware is introduced, that entire process has to be redone from scratch.
Today, Dream Labs is coming out of stealth with Dream-1, a robot foundation model that controls bimanual robots it has never seen, on tasks it was never shown, in places it has never been, from $3/hour.
Dream API is live for everyone, today. 🧵 pic.twitter.com/MB1snhUOAJ
— Dream Labs (@dreamlabs_ai) October 19, 2026
Jang believes there should be an easier way to train robots to perform new tasks, and his solution is a highly versatile foundation model called Dream-1, which is designed to be a “universal brain” for robots. Dream-1 treats robotic skills as simple video prediction problems. It teaches robots using what Jang calls “human egocentric training data,” which is a fancy term for videos of people performing physical tasks such as stacking shelves and packing items in boxes.
By studying these videos, Dream-1 learns to predict what should logically happen next and based on that, it will then determine the physical action the robot needs to perform to ensure it actually happens. The big advantage of teaching robots this way is that video-based data is much easier to accumulate than specialized machine-specific datasets. It means Dream-1 can quickly amass the data it needs to teach robots new skills, transferring intelligence seamlessly across different types of robotic hardware.
Jang said Dream-1 has been designed to work with any two-armed robot that’s equipped with parallel grippers. The only thing required to get started is a video feed and natural language instructions – basically, someone to tell it what to do.
“The hardware is ready, but what’s been missing is a brain any robot can use,” Jang said. “When you get into a rental car, you don’t relearn how to drive. You find the controls and your past driving experience does the rest. Dream-1 approaches a new robot the same way, so it can do useful work in minutes, not months.”
The next step is making this intelligence universally accessible to developers, and that’s where today’s API launch comes in. Through the Dream API, developers can access Dream-1 and instantly start translating visual inputs and natural language prompts into robotic actions. Dream Labs is charging developers $3 per hour to access the most powerful version of Dream-1, with prices dropping to just 75 cents per hour for a lightweight version.
Dream-1 can also be used to teach robots entirely new skills that the model hasn’t come across before through the startup’s Fine-Tuning-as-a-Service offering. All developers have to do is submit video demonstrating a new task — the more video footage there is, the better — and Dream Labs will turn that into a highly customized version of Dream-1 within a few hours.
To showcase the capabilities of its model, the company has also launched the Robot Playground, which can be accessed by anyone through a web browser. Simply type a command and watch a live robot respond in real time.
Dream Labs is currently working with more than 20 robotic hardware companies whose machines cost anywhere between $2,000 and $10,000. While Dream-1 is designed to work with any robotic arm, the company works with these partners to optimize the model for their specific hardware. This work gives it a better ‘grasp’ of what each robot can do, enabling better performance.
Jang said Dream-1 is already highly capable at tasks such as picking up and placing objects and folding clothes, but he has much bigger ambitions in the long term. For instance, he plans to teach the model to support mobile robots that use wheels and also robots with fully dextrous or humanlike hands. The money from today’s round will help to pay for the necessary compute power to get this done, he said.
Daisy Cai of B Capital said robotic arms can now be bought for the same price as a high-end laptop. “What they need now is intelligence,” she continued. “This team did some of the defining work in robot learning at Nvidia, and now anyone with an API key can build on it.”

articles.title: Instalar la APK de XUPER TV en Android trae mucha publicidad y malware que roba contraseñas bancarias
articles.text:
La descarga de XUPER TV mediante archivos APK externos implica riesgos que exceden la resolución de películas, series o transmisiones en vivo. La aplicación no se distribuye en Google Play Store, así que la instalación depende de páginas de terceros, sin garantías sobre el origen, la integridad o las modificaciones realizadas al archivo.
Ese circuito puede derivar en publicidad invasiva, ralentización del celular, pedidos de permisos que no corresponden con una plataforma streaming y la descarga de programas adicionales.
El Instituto Nacional de Ciberseguridad de España (Incibe) advierte que las aplicaciones maliciosas pueden robar información, bloquear archivos, registrar pulsaciones y acceder a mensajes de texto con códigos de verificación.
Por qué una APK puede traer publicidad invasiva
Una APK es el archivo de instalación de las aplicaciones de Android. El problema aparece cuando se descarga desde sitios no oficiales: el usuario no puede comprobar si se trata de la versión original, una copia modificada o un instalador que incorpora componentes adicionales.
En el caso de XUPER TV, la falta de una distribución verificable deja esa comprobación en manos de quien descarga el archivo. Una de las consecuencias habituales es la aparición de anuncios fuera de la aplicación, redirecciones a sitios web y ventanas emergentes.
Incibe señala que algunas apps de dudosa procedencia utilizan este mecanismo para mostrar publicidad no deseada o recopilar datos. El celular puede consumir más batería, datos y recursos del sistema, lo que afecta su funcionamiento cotidiano.
Qué permisos deben generar alerta en el teléfono
Una aplicación destinada a reproducir contenido audiovisual puede necesitar acceso a internet o al almacenamiento para guardar configuraciones. Sin embargo, los permisos para leer mensajes SMS, activar servicios de accesibilidad, instalar otras apps, acceder a contactos, cámara, micrófono o ubicación requieren una revisión adicional.
Los permisos excesivos pueden facilitar el acceso a archivos personales y a funciones sensibles del dispositivo. Si una APK solicita autorizaciones ajenas a la reproducción de video, conviene rechazarlas y evaluar la desinstalación.
Incibe sugiere revisar cada permiso antes de aceptarlo, ya que estas autorizaciones pueden abrir la puerta a la extracción de fotos, documentos, datos de contacto y otra información almacenada.
Cómo puede una XUPER TV robar contraseñas bancarias
Una aplicación maliciosa puede incorporar un keylogger, una herramienta que registra las pulsaciones realizadas en la pantalla. Con ese mecanismo, los atacantes pueden capturar usuarios, contraseñas y códigos introducidos en aplicaciones bancarias, redes sociales, correos electrónicos u otros servicios.
Otra modalidad consiste en mostrar pantallas falsas sobre las aplicaciones legítimas. Cuando la persona cree que ingresa sus datos en la app de su banco, en realidad puede entregarlos a un servidor controlado por delincuentes.
El riesgo no depende únicamente de XUPER TV como nombre de la aplicación, sino de los instaladores alterados que circulan en sitios externos y que pueden presentarse como versiones actualizadas o complementos necesarios.
Por qué el acceso a los SMS puede comprometer una cuenta bancaria
Muchas entidades financieras utilizan mensajes SMS para enviar códigos de un solo uso, requeridos para confirmar accesos, transferencias o cambios de contraseña. Si una aplicación maliciosa obtiene permiso para leer esos mensajes, puede ver el contenido de esos códigos y utilizarlos junto con las credenciales capturadas.
El acceso a los SMS puede anular una capa de seguridad bancaria cuando el atacante ya conoce el usuario y la clave. Incibe incluye este escenario entre las amenazas de las apps maliciosas en celulares.
Por esa razón, una solicitud para gestionar, leer o enviar mensajes debe considerarse incompatible con una plataforma streaming y requiere una revisión inmediata.
De qué forma un virus puede secuestrar archivos personales
El riesgo alcanza a las fotos, videos, documentos y grabaciones guardadas en el dispositivo. Un archivo APK modificado puede instalar un programa de tipo ransomware, que bloquea o cifra la información y exige un pago a cambio de una supuesta recuperación.
El pago no garantiza que los archivos vuelvan a estar disponibles. Las copias de seguridad son una medida de protección frente a este tipo de incidentes.

articles.title: AWOL Vision Opens Pre-Orders for LuxVision: World's First Optical-Shift 4K 120Hz Projector
articles.text:
Monday, October 19th 2026
AWOL Vision Opens Pre-Orders for LuxVision: World's First Optical-Shift 4K 120Hz Projector
AWOL Vision, a global home entertainment brand delivering immersive audiovisual experiences through large-format displays, home cinema technology, and connected entertainment, announced that the AWOL LuxVision, first unveiled at IFA 2026, is now officially available for pre-order. Customers can reserve LuxVision with a $100 / €100 / £100 deposit to unlock exclusive Super Early Bird Benefits ahead of its official launch.
This world's first UST projector with optional lens shift is designed to adapt to the changing ways people use their big screens, delivering a tailored experience for every scenario. The big screen is no longer just for movie nights. Gaming is moving toward higher frame rates, sports fans are following multiple live events at once, and home theaters are becoming a more integrated part of everyday living spaces.Built for Every Big Screen Moment
Today's gamers expect a big screen to be just as fast and responsive as the games they play. Size alone isn't enough when the experience can't keep pace with the action. LuxVision delivers 4K at 120 Hz from input to output, bringing sharper, smoother motion to the giant screen. With 1 ms input lag at 4K 120 Hz, VRR and ALLM, gameplay stays fast and responsive. 6,000 ISO lumens help maintain vivid images even in real-home lighting, while Dolby Vision Gaming further enhances compatible titles. Together, these features bring the high refresh rates, brightness and low latency of modern gaming to a truly cinematic scale.
Bringing that big screen experience home means making it work with the space you already have. Lens shift has long given long-throw projectors more flexibility in installation, but UST owners haven't had the same option. LuxVision changes that with the industry's first vertical lens shift for UST, allowing users to move the image vertically within a 142-152% offset range without cropping, scaling, or sacrificing true 4K detail. This makes it easier to install, fine-tune, or upgrade a UST setup without having to reposition the screen or replace existing furniture. Combined with its 0.18:1 ultra-short-throw ratio, LuxVision can project a 120-inch image from just 7.5 inches away, bringing a giant screen into the room while taking up remarkably little space.
And all that big screen can do more than show one thing at a time. For sports fans, that means no longer having to choose between games when several big matchups are happening at once. With LuxVision's optional Multiview upgrade, users can connect multiple wired and wireless sources and enjoy up to four views simultaneously on one massive screen. Viewers can keep the main event front and center while following other matchups and key moments at the same time, turning the screen into a complete game-day hub.
Behind all of these experiences is AWOL's flagship imaging platform. LuxVision features an RGB triple-laser light source covering 110% of Rec 2020, along with a 10,000:1 native contrast ratio with IRIS, seven-level Dynamic IRIS and Enhanced Black Level (EBL) technology. It also supports Dolby Vision, HDR10+ and IMAX Enhanced. Anti-RBE Technology II is designed to reduce rainbow artifacts during both 2D and 3D viewing.
Price and Availability
LuxVision is available for reservation from September 14 through November 2 on AWOL's official website. Customers who place a $100, €100, or £100 deposit can lock in the LuxVision Cinema System Launch Offer, which includes the LuxVision Cinema System and one of two eligible screen options: a 100"-150" New Gen Fresnel ALR Screen ($999-$4,999) or a 100"-120" New Gen Floor-Rising ALR Screen ($1,999-$2,999). 
LuxVision will officially launch on November 3, with an MSRP of $5,999 / €5,999 / £4,999. 
LuxVision is offered in three standard finishes: Eclipse Platinum, Boreal Oak, and Champagne Walnut. Customers may also choose a Custom CMF (Color, Material, and Finish) option for an additional $1,000 or add 4-channel HDMI Multiview for an additional $500.

articles.title: Trump administration orders ban on DeepSeek in federal agencies - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Trump administration orders ban on DeepSeek in federal agencies
The Department of Homeland Security has ordered artificial intelligence technology from the Chinese company DeepSeek Ltd. be removed from all federal civilian agencies.
The order, published on the Federal Register website today, warned that DeepSeek’s AI models present “multiple threat vectors,” that could give the Chinese Communist Party “extensive authority” to access American government infrastructure.
DeepSeek doesn’t even make the top 10 in a recent government survey where people expressed their opinion of AI models, but in 2025 the free app was downloaded by millions of Americans to the consternation of the U.S government. At the time a full ban of the app was mulled in the U.S., with one cybersecurity expert calling DeepSeek’s privacy policy not “worth the paper it is written on.”
The new order from the DHS means all civilian agency information technology systems will now have to remove all any products affiliated with DeepSeek from their systems, which includes third-party services developed using the app. Going forward, all purchases of DeepSeek’s products and services are verboten in those agencies. The DHS justified the move by invoking the 2018 Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act following a review of the matter by the Federal Acquisition Security Council.
The DHS subsequently warned that the technology poses a danger to the U.S. in various forms. The agency explained that it could be used to “track or digitally fingerprint” users and may “transfer of sensitive data to the People’s Republic of China if used by U.S. government or vendors.”
The U.S. crackdown on DeepSeek had been brewing since last year, when the company stunned the tech industry with the release of its R1 model. Despite being trained using less powerful chips and at a fraction of the cost of some competing models, the open-source AI system outperformed models developed by American rivals OpenAI and Anthropic in several complex tests.
The Commerce Department last year banned DeepSeek from government devices, while the U.S. Navy directed all its members not to use the model because of potential security concerns. New York State banned DeepSeek from government devices and networks over “serious concerns” over potential data privacy and censorship risks posed by the app.
DeepSeek released its latest AI model, V4.1 Flash-1017 just recently. The upgraded model promised faster performance and improved reasoning and coding capabilities, with early reports suggesting it could compete with some of the most advanced American AI systems.

Belkin has launched a new lineup of Bluetooth trackers to help customers locate their belongings whether they’re using an iPhone or an Android device.
Belkin’s SureFind collection consists of three products: the SureFind Spot, SureFind Card, and SureFind Loop Cable Tag.
And every product in the range works with Apple’s Find My and Google’s Find Hub so you’ll be able to locate what’s important to you no matter what smartphone you’re using.
Each device features audio alerts through the built-in speakers so you can find nearby items faster, while left-behind reminders can alert you if you and your phone are leaving your belongings behind.
And they can also be tracked on the Find My app on iPhones and the Find Hub app on Google devices.
SUREFIND SPOT BLUETOOTH TRACKER – $29.95, $54.95 (2 Pack), $99.95 (3 Pack)
The SureFind Spot Tracker is compact and small enough to attach to keys, backpacks, and luggage, along with other belongings that you may misplace.
Spot can help you find the things you’re looking for when you need them most.
SureFind Spot key features include:
– Works with Apple Find My and Google’s Find Hub on Apple and Android devices
– Easily locate keys, bags, luggage and everyday items from your smartphone
– Built-in loop and included lanyard attach easily without an extra holder
– Loud audio alert helps find nearby belongings fast
– Left-behind reminders help prevent loss before it happens
– Up to 12 months of battery life with replaceable battery
– Water-resistant design for everyday carry
– Made with 85% recycled plastic
SUREFIND CARD BLUETOOTH TRACKER – $44.95
The SureFind Card tracker is ideal to fit into wallets, passport holders, and other slim carry items. It has an IP68 rating and all the same features as the other SureFind trackers to ensure you and your belongings are not separated.
SureFind Card key features include:
– Works with Apple Find My and Google’s Find Hub on Apple and Android devices
– Ultra-slim design fits easily into wallets, passports and bags
– Included strap offers flexible attachment to luggage and everyday essentials
– Loud audio alert helps find nearby belongings fast
– Left-behind reminders help prevent loss before it happens
– IP68-rated for water and dust resistance

SUREFIND LOOP CABLE TAG RECHARGEABLE BLUETOOTH TRACKER – $44.95
The SureFind Loop cable tag combines two essentials into one.
First, it contains item tracking technology and second, it has a built-in USB-C to USB-C charging cable.
It’s also secure enough to attach to luggage, backpacks, and handbags and can also be used as a charging cable whenever you need it.
SureFind Loop Cable Tag key features include:
– Works with Apple Find My and Google’s Find Hub for broad compatibility

articles.title: “No estamos prestando atención a los riesgos y ni a sus daños”, Bill Gates sobre el avance global de la IA
articles.text:
Bill Gates advirtió en una entrevista en el Vaticano que los riesgos de la inteligencia artificial (IA) requieren una respuesta pública que el sector tecnológico no puede resolver por sí solo.
El fundador de Microsoft sostuvo que gobiernos y actores neutrales deben intervenir en un escenario marcado por el desarrollo acelerado de sistemas capaces de igualar o superar algunas capacidades cognitivas humanas.
“Creo que no estamos prestando atención a los riesgos y que no estamos haciendo lo suficiente para minimizar los daños”, afirmó. El empresario alertó sobre la posibilidad de que las herramientas más avanzadas queden concentradas en quienes puedan pagar por ellas.
A la vez, dijo que tampoco se aprovechan de forma suficiente las oportunidades de la inteligencia artificial para reducir desigualdades en salud, educación y agricultura.
Cuáles son los riesgos del avance de la IA, según Bill Gates
Gates alertó que la inteligencia artificial puede ampliar la capacidad de daño de los ciberdelincuentes con pocos recursos, porque la tecnología puede facilitar la sofisticación de fraudes, deepfakes, desinformación y ciberataques.
Ante los riesgos, el empresario afirmó: “El sector no puede autorregularse, debe estar guiado por actores neutrales, en primer lugar, los gobiernos”. El desafío está en que una parte importante de los funcionarios responsables de tomar decisiones no comprende con suficiente profundidad el funcionamiento de estas herramientas.
Cómo puede la inteligencia artificial reducir o ampliar las desigualdades
El empresario puso el foco en usos concretos de la IA en países de ingresos bajos y medios. Mencionó la posibilidad de que médicos rurales usen un celular como ecógrafo, que estudiantes reciban apoyo personalizado según sus formas de aprendizaje y que agricultores accedan a sugerencias adaptadas al suelo y al clima de cada zona.
Estas aplicaciones, advirtió, no se extenderán de manera automática. “Si se dejan en manos del mercado, las herramientas más eficaces se desarrollarán primero para quienes puedan pagar más, no para quienes más las necesitan”, sostuvo.
Por qué Bill Gates compara a la IA con un evento evolutivo
Para Gates, el actual proceso tecnológico se diferencia de innovaciones anteriores, como la computadora personal o Internet. Esos cambios alteraron actividades y mercados, pero terminaron por ofrecer herramientas de uso masivo.
La IA, en cambio, plantea un desafío distinto por su capacidad para realizar tareas vinculadas con el razonamiento, el lenguaje y la producción de contenidos.
Gates afirmó que se parece “más a un evento evolutivo” porque la humanidad creó “un tipo de inteligencia que, en muchos aspectos, iguala o supera la cognición humana”. A su juicio, describirla como la siguiente computadora personal lleva a subestimar su alcance.
Qué obstáculos pueden aumentar la brecha entre países
Gates dividió el futuro próximo en dos etapas. La primera es una transición en la que los beneficios de la IA todavía no llegan de forma amplia, mientras las economías más ricas concentran buena parte de los avances y de la infraestructura necesaria para usarlos.
Uno de los problemas que mencionó es el predominio del inglés en el entrenamiento de los modelos. Esa limitación, señaló, deja en desventaja a miles de millones de personas que se comunican en otros idiomas.
El empresario reclamó cambios en la forma de gravar el trabajo frente a la automatización y una definición sobre qué tareas deben permanecer deliberadamente en manos humanas.
Cuál futuro le puede deparar a la humanidad ante el avance de la IA
Gates describió un escenario de abundancia, con sistemas de inteligencia artificial y robots humanoides que asuman tareas ligadas a la alimentación, la vivienda y otras necesidades básicas. Ese contexto abriría preguntas sobre el trabajo, el uso del tiempo y el sentido de la vida social.
Antes de llegar a esa instancia, el foco debe estar en los riesgos inmediatos. Gates dijo que su objetivo para los próximos años es evitar “ataques bioterroristas catastróficos” e incidentes de seguridad informática, sumado a impedir que amplios sectores del mercado laboral y grandes regiones queden excluidos de los beneficios tecnológicos.

articles.title: 'AI is no longer just supporting the business — it has become the business model': IBM VP tells us how your business can balance AI excitement with realism as governance becomes more important than ever
articles.text:
'AI is no longer just supporting the business — it has become the business model': IBM VP tells us how your business can balance AI excitement with realism as governance becomes more important than ever
A lot needs to be done to scale AI, IBM warns
As excitement around AI continues to build among businesses of all sizes, many leading voices are urging caution for those who might scale too quickly.
At its recent Think EMEA event in London, IBM revealed research which claimed efforts to stay aware of potential risks and challenges posed by AI deployment and scaling are falling somewhat short of expectations.
So what can companies do in order to balance the hype and excitement around what AI can offer, with the need for sensible and thorough governance.
AI as the enabler
"What we are seeing is that if you don't provide an answer to security, to accountability, to responsibility, it is going to be very hard to scale AI in the corporate environment - particularly when we're talking about highly regulated industries - so for us, it's more of an enabler, than something that is going to slow down the adoption,” Ana Paula Assis, Senior Vice President and Chair for IBM EMEA and APAC told us in response to that very question during a media Q&A at the event.
“The question here is really, how do you balance the speed of innovation with the implementation of governance?”
IBM recently released research on the current state of AI and governance, finding that 80% of the companies surveyed claimed that an AI incident had been escalated to board level. However only 40% of those had then been able to use the incident to secure new investment in governance, or cement a new policy.
“I think the reason for that is because it's very hard to balance that innovation with the application of tools, processes, methodologies, to ensure that you are deploying AI at scale in a safe way,” Assis continued.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
IBM is reportedly well placed to discuss such growth and progress with AI, with the company’s earlier keynote at Think EMEA claiming it had seen savings of around $5.5 billion in terms of improved productivity and efficiency utilizing AI to improve core processes - money that it was able to redirect to areas including R&D and innovation.
“But we are seeing this as an enabler, and as a key component of the architecture for agentic AI going forward, because these companies have tremendous responsibility - they need to ensure that they have trust from their clients, and they will only be able to do that if they have AI that they can observe and that they can govern.”
“AI is no longer just supporting the business,” Assis said. “It has become the business model. The organizations pulling ahead are not just adding AI, but rethinking how systems, decisions and processes work together with AI.”

articles.title: Renault prépare du lourd pour les Scénic et Rafale électriques : 750 km d’autonomie et charge ultra-rapide à la clé
articles.text:
Renault prépare du lourd pour les Scénic et Rafale électriques : 750 km d’autonomie et charge ultra-rapide à la clé
Renault accélère sur la voiture électrique en développant une nouvelle plateforme bien plus performante pour ses SUV : le Scénic et le Rafale. Une évolution marquante qui promet de transformer la gamme dans les années à venir.
L’endurance des voitures électriques de Renault n’a pas fini de s’améliorer. Pour continuer sa conquête de ce marché, le patron de la marque vient de confirmer que les efforts se concentrent massivement sur le renouvellement des populaires gammes Scénic et Rafale à l’horizon 2028-2030. L’objectif serait d’atteindre les 750 km d’autonomie tout en offrant une recharge rapide digne de ce nom.
Un bond technologique majeur pour les prochains Scénic et Rafale, l’E-Space attendra
Au détour du Salon de l’Auto de Paris 2026, Autocar a eu droit à quelques confidences de Fabrice Cambolive, patron de Renault. Interrogé sur le potentiel lancement de l’E-Space, conceptualisé pour l’occasion, le dirigeant avoue que la marque n’est “pas capable de tout embrasser en même temps” et que ce monospace rétro “n’est pas un projet concret pour le moment”.
Alors que la priorité de 2027 sera le lancement du Trafic E-Tech, il précise la suite du programme : “la prochaine étape après cela sera le renouvellement des Scénic et Rafale, et ensuite nous devrons décider quel sera le prochain Espace”.
Pour ces deux modèles phares, la révolution passera par la nouvelle plateforme RGEV Medium 2.0. Dotée d’une architecture 800 volts, fraîchement inaugurée sur son dernier utilitaire électrique, cette base technique balayera enfin la limite actuelle des 150 kW en courant continu. Concrètement, passer de 10 à 80 % de batterie ne demandera plus que 20 minutes, contre une demi-heure aujourd’hui.
Le rayon d’action grimperait quant à lui jusqu’à 750 km sur le cycle WLTP en version 100 % électrique, voire près de 1 400 km avec un prolongateur d’autonomie. Un bond en avant conséquent alors que les modèles actuels de la gamme atteignent les 625 km pour le Scénic E-Tech Grande Autonomie et 1 000 km pour le Rafale hybride rechargeable.
Fabrice Cambolive assure ensuite que les lignes de son SUV actuel seront conservées, précisant que “le travail que nous avons accompli en termes de design est de qualité, donc le Scénic de nouvelle génération devrait vraiment rester fidèle à ce design”. Il adoptera toutefois un habitacle typé monospace ultra modulable ainsi que le nouvel écran panoramique OpenR sur toute la largeur du tableau de bord, qui équipera lui aussi le futur Rafale aux alentours de 2030.

articles.title: AI work assistant startup Town secures unicorn status after raising $108M just weeks after launching - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
AI work assistant startup Town secures unicorn status after raising $108M just weeks after launching
Town.com Inc., an artificial intelligence agent startup laser focused on getting work done by collaborating with other AI agents, revealed today that it has raised $108 million in a new funding at a $1 billion valuation.
The Series B round was led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures, and saw participation from Andreessen Horowitz, Serena Ventures and First Round Capital, bringing Town’s total amount raised to date to $160 million, following a $55 million Series A that closed in June.
The startup, co-founded by former Plaid Inc. Chief Technology Officer Jean-Denis Greze, has already achieved a revenue run rate in the millions of dollars just weeks after it launched its first assistants, known as “townies,” in June, according to a blog post by Menlo partners Shawn Carolan, Amy Wu Martin and Sam Borja.
Menlo’s partners explained that Greze was previously in charge of engineering at the financial services firm Plaid, while his co-founder Tony Vincent has been involved in two prior startups: Aspen Designs Inc., which was later acquired by Google LLC, and Sold Inc., which was bought by Dropbox Inc. in 2013. It was after joining Dropbox that Vincent met Greze for the first time, beginning a friendship that ultimately led to the founding of Town.
Town targets businesses, providing each employee with a Townie that helps with tasks by connecting to tools such as emails and calendars, as well as other core work systems. Employees’ Townies can talk to each other and share approved information; they can also now work with customers and others outside the company.
In their blog post, Carolan, Martin and Borja wrote that Menlo’s entire team began using Town in June and, within a very short time, their Townies became their hardest working team members. “A few weeks after we put the firm on Town, our Slack was full of people posting screenshots of their ‘moments of magic,’” the partners wrote. “Townies that had caught commitments people had forgotten, pulled the right context into replies before anyone went looking for it, and held together days that were about to fall apart. More than once, one surfaced a contact or a founder that someone had spent weeks trying to find.”
Where Townies really stand out is through the extent of the business context they understand. In a blog post announcing today’s round, Greze and Vincent explained that Townies don’t just know their users, but also familiarize themselves with each of their colleagues.
As a result, they know how their CEO writes, who has the strongest relationships with each buyer, what each sales lead cares about most, and all of the processes that go into running the business. Because each of these people also has a Townie, they can work together, leveraging their deep understanding of how the company runs.
A crucial benefit for businesses is that Town ensures they own this context, which was previously trapped in the heads of their employees and buried inside their email inboxes. That context had a habit of disappearing whenever someone was too busy, or left the company. Townies ensure that no longer happens, transforming that context into a compounding asset that enables everyone to work faster and smarter.
“We believe that this context is a critical asset and should belong to the company that built it,” Greze and Vincent wrote. “That’s why if you ever leave Town, you can take it with you and use it anywhere.”
Going forward, the co-founders said they’ll use the money from today’s round to build more integrations to expand the usefulness of their Townies as they strive to become a permanent fixture in employees’ daily lives. While their capabilities are impressive, Townies still need to demonstrate longevity to justify the startup’s new unicorn valuation.

articles.title: Ivre, il transforme ses airpod en Wiimote
articles.text:
Les AirPods savent suivre les mouvements de votre tête. Avec BipBop, ce sont désormais ceux de votre main qui comptent : ces applications gratuites transforment un écouteur Apple en Wiimote pour 30 mini-jeux d'arcade sur Mac.
Le suivi des mouvements intégré aux AirPods sert habituellement à adapter l'audio spatial aux déplacements de la tête. BipBop exploite cette même technologie pour un usage nettement plus ludique : piloter des jeux vidéo avec un écouteur tenu à la main. Développé comme un projet indépendant, ce petit logiciel gratuit propose une collection de 30 jeux d'arcade accessibles depuis une seule application.
- Une collection de 30 mini-jeux
- Visée pilotée par un AirPod
- Jeu sans compte ni connexion
Un AirPod en guise de Wiimote, 30 jeux pour en profiter
BipBop reprend un principe popularisé par la Wiimote de Nintendo : utiliser les mouvements d'un objet tenu en main pour contrôler ce qui se passe à l'écran. Ici, pas besoin de télécommande dédiée. Un AirPod compatible avec le suivi de la tête fait l'affaire, à condition de le connecter à un Mac et de désactiver la détection automatique des oreilles.
Une fois l'écouteur calibré, ses mouvements permettent notamment de déplacer un viseur dans les jeux de tir. Pour déclencher une action, BipBop propose deux méthodes : produire un petit bruit près du microphone de l'AirPod ou utiliser une pression directement sur l'écouteur. Cette seconde commande est encore expérimentale, tandis que la première peut réagir à des bruits parasites. Pas forcément l'idéal pour établir un record dans une pièce bruyante.
Le catalogue reprend les grands classiques des salles d'arcade, avec des parties conçues pour être courtes. Duck Hunt propose de tirer sur des canards, tandis que Bowling, Darts et Mini Golf s'intéressent à la précision du geste. On trouve également du tennis, du ski, des courses automobiles, des jeux de plateforme et quelques casse-têtes. Les 30 titres sont inclus dans le téléchargement, sans achats supplémentaires.
Une expérience gratuite, mais réservée aux Mac récents
BipBop fonctionne sur les Mac équipés d'une puce Apple Silicon M1 ou ultérieure, sous macOS 14 minimum. Il faut également posséder des AirPods compatibles avec le suivi des mouvements de la tête. Les machines Intel, Windows et les appareils iOS ne sont pas pris en charge par cette version.
L'application ne demande ni création de compte, ni abonnement, ni connexion Internet pour jouer. Les meilleurs scores, la progression et les parties interrompues sont enregistrés localement. Selon les indications du projet, les données audio utilisées pour détecter les commandes sont analysées en mémoire, sans enregistrement ni transmission.
Attention toutefois à son statut : BipBop est actuellement distribué en version expérimentale 0.8.3, sans certification notariale d'Apple. macOS peut donc bloquer son ouverture initiale, et mieux vaut s'assurer de la provenance du programme avant d'autoriser son exécution.
L'idée d'exploiter les AirPods comme contrôleurs n'est pas totalement nouvelle. En octobre 2025, RidePods utilisait déjà les mouvements de tête pour piloter une moto sur iPhone. BipBop pousse le concept plus loin en proposant un écouteur à tenir en main et une trentaine de jeux aux mécaniques variées. Reste à voir si la précision et la latence des commandes permettent réellement d'en profiter dans la durée.
En attendant, voilà au moins une utilisation des AirPods qu'Apple n'avait probablement pas prévue.
- Une collection de 30 mini-jeux
- Visée pilotée par un AirPod
- Jeu sans compte ni connexion

articles.title: Star Wars Battlefront 3 on the Cards for Bungie if DICE Passes It Up
articles.text:
Monday, October 19th 2026
Star Wars Battlefront 3 on the Cards for Bungie if DICE Passes It Up
Star Wars Battlefront has long been a staple for the Star Wars game franchise, with a recent remake of the 2011 game drawing in over 35,000 peak concurrent players on Steam. According to a recent issue of the Electronic Gaming Monthly magazine, as featured in a recent Giant Bomb Game Mess Mornings podcast, Lucasfilm is eyeing Battlefront 3, with Bungie being one of the studios in the running to create the game. The company is allegedly still deliberating which studio to partner with on the new game, suggesting that Battlefront 3 won't be launching anytime soon.
Electronic Gaming Monthly via Giant BombAccording to what your intrepid rumormonger has dug up, the suits at Lucasfilm have been aggressively deploying probe droids for a development partner to take on the task of creating a follow-up. So far, no one has fully stepped up, but yours truly is hearing two major game studios are circling the project like a couple of snowspeeders—led by the completely unsurprising EA DICE, who we can hope learned from their loot box lesson. Duh. We can expect that one. Here's the other one: There is another. The Quartermann hears that if the Force is not entrusted to DICE, it could land at none other than Halo, Destiny, and Marathon developer Bungie.
For the time being, it seems as though EA's DICE is still the frontrunner for the development of Star Wars Battlefront 3, but EA has consistently shown that its main cash cow is the Battlefield franchise, with a recent move pivoting Criterion Games, the studio known for Burnout and Need for Speed, to Battlefield support studios following a devastating round of layoffs. In spite of its recent stumble with Marathon, Bungie also has a solid foundation in shooters, and it may be interesting to see what Bungie could do with a Battlefront game, given its expertise in high-mobility games and shooters in general, like Destiny and Halo. 
Bungie developing Star Wars Battlefront 3 would also have implications for the gameplay, given PlayStation's recent pivot to only porting games to PC when those PC ports can "maximize" the gaming experience, effectively limiting those ports to live-service games. 
Sources:
				Giant Bomb on YouTube, 				Electronic Gaming Monthly Magazine

articles.title: EcoFlow's new Titan 5000 home battery systems get $50 reservation launch
articles.text:
EcoFlow's new Titan 5000 home battery range promises serious backup power, and $50 gets you an early discount and free solar panels
The three models are Titan 5000 Classic, Titan 5000, and Titan 5000 Plus
EcoFlow has unveiled a new range of home backup batteries designed to keep essential appliances running during power outages, with enough capacity to provide electricity for several days. The Titan 5000 series includes three models, with a $50 reservation securing a 5% discount and two free 220W solar panels.
• Best for: Homeowners who want a good amount of backup power, particularly those concerned about outages or looking to make better use of solar energy.
• Why it matters: These aren't ordinary portable power stations. They're expandable home energy systems designed to supply thousands of watts of electricity and integrate with selected household circuits.
• What you need to know: The offer ends on November 2, and EcoFlow hasn't revealed shipping dates yet.
Best EcoFlow Titan 5000 deals
This home battery system offers 5kWh expandable storage, 4000W output, 120V power, 3200W solar input, automatic backup switching, smart app control, and compatibility with EcoFlow's Smart Home Panel 10 system.
This home battery system features 5kWh expandable storage, 7200W output, 120V/240V support, 4000W solar input, automatic backup switching, smart energy management, and compatibility with EcoFlow's Smart Home Panel 10 system.
This advanced home battery system features 5kWh expandable storage, 7200W output, 8000W solar input, PV Boost technology, 120V/240V support, automatic backup switching, smart energy management, and home integration capabilities.
Why we recommend taking a closer look
The Titan series offers the ability to choose how much electricity you want to store separately from how much power you need to deliver. The 5kWh starting capacity is useful for shorter outages, while expansion batteries can increase the available runtime.
A 5kWh battery could theoretically power a continuous 500W load for around 10 hours, although the actual runtime will vary because of conversion losses and other factors.
Expanding to 30kWh provides six times the stored energy, but additional batteries increase the total cost.
The Titan systems also offer automatic backup switching within 20 milliseconds, while the compatible Smart Home Panel 10 can manage up to ten selected circuits. EcoFlow's OASIS 3.0 software adds monitoring and energy management, including the ability to schedule charging around electricity tariffs.
Three models, three different power requirements
The entry-level EcoFlow Titan 5000 Classic starts at $2,499 and provides 4,000W of output. It can power essential 120V appliances, including fridges, lighting, and more. It comes with approximately 5kWh of battery storage, expandable to 30kWh with additional batteries. Solar charging supports up to 3,200W of input.
The Classic only provides 120V output, so if you need more power consider the Titan 5000. Priced at $3,199, it gives you 7,200W of output and support for both 120V and 240V appliances. Solar input also increases to 4,000W, and the system works with EcoFlow's 240V Smart Home Panel 10 for automatic backup of selected household circuits.
The $3,699 Titan 5000 Plus shares the standard model's 7,200W battery output but doubles the maximum solar input to 8,000W, using two independent 4,000W MPPT controllers. Its PV Boost technology can increase available output to 10,000W when enough solar power is available.
Which EcoFlow Titan 5000 should you buy?
✅ Buy the Titan 5000 Classic if...
You mainly want to keep essential 120V equipment running during power outages and don't need backup for large 240V appliances.
✅ Buy the Titan 5000 if...
You want 120V/240V backup power and enough output to support more demanding household equipment.
✅ Buy the Titan 5000 Plus if...
You have substantial solar generation capacity or want the additional power options for demanding appliances. Its 8kW solar input and PV Boost capability are the main benefits.
